notes: Variant unit WLC.2KI.20.18.v002 is selected to r00-base, covering s011; the ASV's 'shall they take away' matches it and no token is left over.

The 'away' of 'take away' is kept with יִקָּחוּ as its phrasal particle, on the ground that לקח in this deportation sense is the carrying off and 'take' alone leaves that short, as rule 44 keeps 'away' with סוּר. The competing reading marks it added under the same rule's surplus-particle test, as 'forward' is for הלך; the two turn on whether the bare English verb already writes the source lexeme.
